ORDER BY achievement.guidance_start_date DESC, achievement.achievement_id DESC LIMIT #{criteria.safePageSize} OFFSET #{criteria.offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student_guidance_achievements achievement JOIN users owner ON owner.user_id = achievement.target_user_id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_guidance_achievements (management_no, target_user_id, evaluation_year, management_item_code, guidance_start_date, guidance_end_date, student_count, certification_status, attachment_ref, deleted_yn, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{managementNo}, #{targetUserId}, #{evaluationYear}, #{managementItemCode}, #{guidanceStartDate}, #{guidanceEndDate}, #{studentCount}, 'DRAFT', #{attachmentRef}, 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE student_guidance_achievements SET management_item_code = #{managementItemCode}, guidance_start_date = #{guidanceStartDate}, guidance_end_date = #{guidanceEndDate}, student_count = #{studentCount}, attachment_ref = #{attachmentRef}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND deleted_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_guidance_students (achievement_id, student_detail_jsonb, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{achievementId}, CAST(#{studentDetail} AS jsonb), #{userId}, #{userId})

INSERT INTO education_achievement_status_histories ( achievement_type, achievement_id, previous_status, next_status, action_type, reason_code, opinion, processed_by, processed_at ) VALUES ( #{history.achievementType}, #{history.achievementId}, #{history.previousStatus}, #{history.nextStatus}, #{history.actionType}, #{history.reasonCode}, #{history.opinion}, #{history.processedBy}, #{history.processedAt} )

INSERT INTO data_change_histories ( target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id ) VALUES ( #{targetBusiness}, #{targetKey}, #{changeType}, #{fieldName}, #{beforeValue}, #{afterValue}, #{changedBy}, #{changeReason}, #{requestId} )

INSERT INTO excel_upload_files (upload_id, business_type, template_id, file_token, original_file_name, validation_status, uploader_user_id) VALUES (#{uploadId}, 'STUDENT_GUIDANCE', #{templateId}, CONCAT('student-guidance-', #{uploadId}), #{originalFileName}, #{validationStatus}, #{userId})

INSERT INTO excel_upload_staging_rows (staging_row_id, upload_id, row_number, row_payload, validation_status) VALUES (#{stagingRowId}, #{uploadId}, #{rowNumber}, CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb), #{validationStatus})

INSERT INTO excel_upload_errors (error_id, upload_id, row_number, column_name, input_value, error_code, error_reason, correction_guide) VALUES (#{errorId}, #{uploadId}, #{rowNumber}, #{columnName}, #{inputValue}, #{errorCode}, #{errorReason}, #{correctionGuide})

INSERT INTO excel_upload_histories (upload_id, total_count, success_count, error_count, excluded_count, saved_count, processing_time_millis, processor_user_id) VALUES (#{uploadId}, #{totalCount}, #{successCount}, #{errorCount}, 0, #{savedCount}, 0, #{userId}) ON CONFLICT (upload_id) DO UPDATE SET total_count = EXCLUDED.total_count, success_count = EXCLUDED.success_count, error_count = EXCLUDED.error_count, saved_count = EXCLUDED.saved_count, processed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, processor_user_id = EXCLUDED.processor_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM excel_upload_errors WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND status != 'DELETED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM excel_upload_files WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND business_type = 'STUDENT_GUIDANCE' AND status != 'DELETED'
SELECT row_number AS "rowNumber", row_payload::text AS "payload" FROM excel_upload_staging_rows WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND validation_status = 'NORMAL' ORDER BY row_number
mapper.update: UPDATE excel_upload_files SET validation_status = 'COMMITTED' WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM excel_upload_staging_rows WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND validation_status = 'NORMAL'
mapper.select: SELECT row_number AS "rowNumber", column_name AS "columnName", input_value AS "inputValue", error_code AS "errorCode", error_reason AS "errorReason", correction_guide AS "correctionGuide" FROM excel_upload_errors WHERE upload_id = #{uploadId} AND status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY row_number, column_name

SELECT history.upload_id AS "uploadId", file.original_file_name AS "originalFileName", history.total_count AS "totalCount", history.success_count AS "successCount", history.error_count AS "errorCount", history.saved_count AS "savedCount", history.processed_at AS "processedAt" FROM excel_upload_histories history JOIN excel_upload_files file ON file.upload_id = history.upload_id WHERE file.business_type = 'STUDENT_GUIDANCE' AND file.uploader_user_id = #{userId} AND history.status != 'DELETED' ORDER BY history.processed_at DESC
